body:
By now, you’ve had a little time to get to know the new LaLa 3-in-1 Convertible Crib, our modern-meets-traditional narrow-slat chameleon that we think is the perfect simple canvas to anchor just about any nursery.

And so far, it seems like you love LaLa as much as we do! Check out baby’s first few 5-star reviews!

“A+ Crib!

I recently bought the Lala crib in walnut and it's been fantastic! The assembly was quick and easy, and the crib feels very sturdy. I love the simple, modern design—it looks great in our nursery. The adjustable mattress height is super convenient. Most importantly, it feels safe and secure. Overall, I’m really happy with this purchase and would definitely recommend the Lala crib to other parents.”

“Great Crib!

Could not have asked for a better crib! The quality is top notch and it was super easy to to put together.”


“dadada Baby Doesn’t Miss!

All of our children’s furniture is dadada Baby and it is all amazing! The quality, the safety, the aesthetic, all things that are important to me as a mom. My first son has a dadada Baby crib and now my second child will have the Lala Crib when he/she is here! The walnut color is gorgeous, and super high quality at a very reasonable price point. It was so easy to put together I (almost) could do it by myself! Can’t wait to have my 2nd baby sleep in this dreamy crib!”

We’re so glad you’re feeling the LaLa-love - and we’re thrilled to introduce you to the rest of the LaLa family!

This month, the LaLa Little and LaLa Big Dressers are joining the LaLa Collection.

We knew a crib as versatile as LaLa would wind up in nurseries of all shapes and sizes, so we designed two unique dressers to fit your specific nursery needs. LaLa Little and LaLa Big pair perfectly with the LaLa Crib in White, and look great in the nursery or anywhere else you need a few extra drawers! Whether you’ve got a small space where every square foot matters, or room to spare, we’ve got a new LaLa dresser designed to work for you!

When you need to maximize storage in the smallest spaces, the 40” LaLa Little 3-drawer Dresser is a small-in-stature but big-in-storage solution. The LaLa Little has three deep drawers designed to make the most of limited square footage and add organization, beauty, and flow to your nursery!


When you have space to spare, well, there’s no such thing as too much storage! The 58” LaLa Big 6-drawer Dresser is an organized parent’s dream. With six deep drawers to store all of baby’s necessities, accessories, and gear, it’s perfect for a maximized, high-function, and timeless nursery set-up where everything has its place.


Both the LaLa Little and the LaLa Big come with durable melamine and rubberwood handles and legs that are built to withstand bumps and scratches, and anti-tip hardware helps keep everyone safe.

LaLa Little & Big Dressers are both available now!

Ready for you to shop, style, and store all your baby must-haves. It’s our hope that with the addition of these two fabulous dressers, you’ll be able to get the storage you need and the style you crave - all within the space you have.

And speaking of the space you have - we would love to see how you’re styling the LaLa 3-in-1 Convertible Crib! If your LaLa is already at home in your nursery, share a picture with us by tagging @dadadababyusa on Instagram so we can celebrate the joyful home you’ve created.
